scope: HUB-08 repair retention-metadata failure atomicity source fix
acceptance_limit: Source-level repair ordering and focused regression only. This is not installed-path evidence, a real corruption/recovery cohort, complete HUB-08 acceptance, F1 acceptance, or F6 acceptance.

confirmed_defect.before: repair_at autocommitted deletion of expired sync_retired_lineages before referenced-pack validation, quarantine counting, retained binding inventory, SQLite quick-check and stale staging cleanup.
confirmed_defect.failure_effect: A later corrupt unexpired retired-lineage manifest could return an error after an otherwise deletion-eligible retired parent and its cascaded pack bindings had already been removed.

implementation.change: Move the unchanged cutoff DELETE to the end of repair_at, after all validation and filesystem cleanup, so it is the final fallible operation before constructing RepairReport.
implementation.sql_predicate_unchanged: expires_at_ms <= now_ms - RETIRED_LINEAGE_PACK_DELETE_GRACE_MS using saturating subtraction
implementation.foreign_key_behavior_unchanged: Deleting an expired parent still cascades to sync_retired_lineage_packs.
implementation.quarantine_behavior_unchanged: Repair still counts and preserves quarantined lifecycle state.
implementation.orphan_behavior_unchanged: Expired retired rows remain excluded from catalog_shas at the same cutoff, so stale staging and unreferenced orphan cleanup retain their prior successful-repair behavior.

ordering_and_semantics.filesystem_before_database: Stale staging and unreferenced orphan cleanup intentionally occur before the final retired-lineage database deletion.
ordering_and_semantics.failure: Any returned validation, query, quick-check or staging-cleanup failure occurs before retired-lineage deletion; the eligible parent and child retention metadata remain byte-for-byte unchanged for retry. Filesystem cleanup is outside this metadata-only atomicity claim.
ordering_and_semantics.delete_failure: The final DELETE is one SQLite statement; a statement failure does not create a later repair failure after a successful metadata deletion.
ordering_and_semantics.success: After all preceding work succeeds, the unchanged cutoff removes expired parents and SQLite cascades their retired pack bindings; the existing report and quarantine/orphan results are returned.
ordering_and_semantics.tradeoff: A failed repair retains expired metadata until a later successful retry instead of reclaiming it before reporting the failure.

focused_regression.name: storage::db::tests::failed_repair_preserves_expired_retired_lineage_metadata
focused_regression.fixture: One deletion-eligible expired parent with its own child pack binding plus one malformed unexpired parent with its own child binding.
focused_regression.failure_assertion: DeserializeManifest is returned and ordered snapshots of both retired tables exactly equal their pre-repair values.
focused_regression.success_assertion: After removing only the injected malformed parent, repair_at at the same now_ms/cutoff removes both the expired parent and its child by cascade.
